title: Efesto labelled Goal/page relevance case (one JSON object per JSONL line)
description: Enforced at load time by validateCase() in scripts/eval/jev-ranking-bench-lib.mjs. Labels must come from real repo test assertions or a named human labeller; never invent labels.

goalMode.description: raw: goal passed to evidenceSupportsGoal exactly as written (direct unit test). goal-manager: goal created through GoalManager.create, so keywords/categories are enriched by enrichGoalIntent. stored: goal object written to the Kernel store as-is.

page.description: The fetched page judged against the Goal. May be {} for 'no evidence' cases.

paddingSuffix.description: Reconstructs fixtures that append char.repeat(count) to text.

relevant.description: Does this page provide evidence relevant to the Goal?

graded.description: Optional human 1-5 grade; null when the source only gives a binary label.

circular.description: true when the label is an assertion on the current ranker's own output (consistency check, not independent ground truth).

file.description: Repo-relative path of the source fixture/test, or 'human' notes location.

snippets.description: Verbatim strings that must appear in file (checked by tests).
